title: A drop that splashes, or doesn't
subtitle: Xu, Zhang and Nagel, 2005: the air decides whether a drop splashes
hook: A drop hits a dry, smooth plate and splashes into a crown. Lower the air pressure around it and the splash disappears. Predict where.

media.alt: A solitary wave runs up a sloping beach around a pier, steepens and breaks, in 3D
media.caption: The lab today: a solitary wave breaking on a beach around a pier, free-surface water in 3D (SPH on the GPU). A splash needs a sharp surface, the air around it and surface tension.

note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
